subject: Security intake: questionnaire preference & SOC 2 timeline
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Security intake: questionnaire preference & SOC 2 timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and the asks from our side to get the vendor intake moving: 

1) Questionnaire format: you mentioned the security team prefers a CAIQ spreadsheet over SIG. Can you confirm that preference so we send the right artifact? We can provide either:
   - CAIQ prefill (XLSX) with citations to our SOC2/HIPAA artifacts, or
   - Standard SIG XML/Excel if you need more narrative answers.

2) SOC 2 status: you asked about SOC 2. We are currently SOC 2 Type II in-progress (control testing completed, report targeted Q1 2027). I can attach an interim SOC control matrix and a gap summary if that helps for your intake.

3) HIPAA / BAA: Do you require a signed BAA before we start a technical deep-dive or is a statement of intent sufficient during the intake?

4) Evidence & dataflow asks: please flag any high-priority items we should prioritize (network diagram, encryption architecture, SSO logs, retention policies, data residency). We can pre-fill the CAIQ with links to a Drive folder containing redacted artifacts.

Attached: post-call-notes (short summary). I also attached a draft prefill template (rwd-prefill-caIQ.xlsx) — if CAIQ is the right path we’ll populate and upload to the Drive link above.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm preferred questionnaire format and whether a BAA is required at intake.
- If CAIQ, we’ll send the prefilled spreadsheet within 48 business hours.
- If helpful, schedule a 60-min technical handoff with Kimberly (security) + your security engineer for deeper evidence review.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on how your vendor process works.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments:
- 20261129-postcall-notes.pdf (summary, 1 page)
- rwd-prefill-caIQ.xlsx (blank prefill template)
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Health Security <security@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security intake: questionnaire preference & SOC 2 timeline

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the concise recap — that mirrors what our team captured. A few clarifications from Nimbus Security: 

- We do prefer a CAIQ spreadsheet as the initial intake. It makes automated parsing for our GRC tool easier. Please populate the CAIQ with links to artifacts where available; we will follow up with requests for specific evidence.

- SOC 2: the SOC2 Type II in-progress note is fine for intake. We will later request the final report when it is available, but for vendor gating we need the SOC control matrix and the testing completion date. If you can indicate the expected final report date (Q1 2027) and provide the interim control matrix, that should be fine to move to the next stage.

- BAA: Nimbus requires an executed BAA for any vendor accessing PHI. For the intake and questionnaire review (non-production demo data), a signed letter of intent referencing the BAA is acceptable, but please flag any work that will involve PHI so we can fast-track BAA review.

- Priority evidence: our immediate asks are (in order): 1) network diagram (redacted), 2) encryption at rest and in transit statements and KMS approach, 3) authentication/SSO and provisioning flow, 4) retention & deletion policy, 5) incident response runbook excerpt.

We'd like the prefilled CAIQ posted to the Drive link you shared. After we review the prefill, we'll schedule a technical review with Kimberly (security lead) and our engineer Sara Patel (cc'd on follow-up). Please also include a short one-page security summary PDF (control highlights) for the security committee.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior IT Risk Manager | Nimbus Health
elena.morales@nimbushealth.com
+1 (650) 777-4040

Elena —

Appreciate the clear direction. We will: 

- Populate the CAIQ prefill and upload to the Drive folder by EOD Tuesday (Wed at the latest). The prefill will include: links to a SOC control matrix (interim), redacted network diagram, KMS/encryption summary, auth diagrams, and retention policy excerpts.

- Attach a one-page security highlights PDF for your committee.

- For the BAA: we will prepare a draft BAA + letter of intent and circulate it to you and your legal team. Kimberly (cc'd) will start the BAA conversation and can join the technical review.

Proposed timing:
- Prefill uploaded: Tue, 2026-12-01 (EOD Pacific)
- Nimbus initial review: Wed-Thu
- Technical review call (30-60 min): Thu 2026-12-03 or Fri 2026-12-04 — please propose a time that works for Sara and your team.

Kimberly, can you confirm availability for a technical call on 12/03 or 12/04 and whether you prefer a full 60-min deep dive or a 30-min focused session on evidence requests?

Thanks — looping in Marissa (solutions) to ensure the Drive package has live links and the CAIQ uses the version of the schema your intake system expects.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
